_comment: Twilio SMS Configuration - Copy this to twilio_config.json and add your credentials
_instructions: 1. Sign up for free Twilio trial at https://www.twilio.com/try-twilio
2. Get your Account SID from the Twilio Console
3. Get your Auth Token from the Twilio Console
4. Get your Twilio phone number (provided during signup)
5. Copy this file to 'twilio_config.json' and fill in your values
6. DO NOT commit twilio_config.json to version control!

_notes.free_tier: Trial credits allow testing SMS functionality
_notes.alternative: Set environment variables instead: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_PHONE_NUMBER
_notes.fallback: Monica uses free Textbelt if Twilio is not configured
